recommendation: Start with a single shared capture inbox before building any automation.
whyNow: The pending question decides who captures tasks; a single capture point removes the largest source of dropped work before anything else is built.
technique: Manual-first capture audit: log every incoming task and its arrival channel for one week before automating anything.
tradeoffs: A single inbox is a bottleneck when its operator is away, but it keeps triage rules simple enough to test by hand.
gotcha: Automating capture before naming an operator usually recreates the pile-up inside the new tool.
evidenceWouldChange: If the week-long audit shows most tasks already arrive in one channel, integrate that channel directly instead of adding a shared inbox.
